title: When greed keeps calling itself need under pressure
issueStatement: The appetite keeps expanding faster than contentment can breathe. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru exposes false wealth and redirects desire toward what actually travels with the soul. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Ask what you are taking in that still leaves the heart poor.
actionPrompt: Ask what you are taking in that still leaves the heart poor. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.

source.shortMeaning: Greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating
source.lifeApplication: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Let the wider window set the tone before the old reflex does.

excerpts.explanation: The line names the pressure without melodrama: greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating.
